<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Heart-Eating Vulture](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2751)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="CE" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=20" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 30

**Perception** +10; low-light vision

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +11, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +12, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +11

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +3

**Con** +5

**Int** +0

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +0
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 21 

**Fort** +13 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 68

</row>

**Immunities**
sickened

**Death Burst** When the heart-eating vulture is slain, its body spasms and thrashes as it falls to the ground while red light begins to shine through splits in its flesh. At the end of the round, the heart-eating vulture explodes into a 10-foot-radius blast of red nindoru butterflies, their razor-sharp wings and claws inflicting 5d6 slashing damage (DC 18 basic Reflex save), leaving behind only the heart it clutched in one of its talons.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 10 feet, fly 35 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
beak +12,
**Damage** 2d8+4 piercing plus carrion fever

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
talon +12 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 2d6+4 slashing

**Carrion Fever**   The [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) condition from carrion fever can't be reduced while the affliction remains; **Saving Throw** DC 18 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 day; **Stage 1** sickened 1 and [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15) (1 day); **Stage 2** sickened 1, slowed 1, and fatigued (1 day)

**Projectile Vomit** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** The giant vulture vomits up its last meal on a creature within 10 feet. The creature takes 3d6 acid damage with a DC 20 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target is also [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34).

</column>
name: Heart-Eating Vulture
